name: Al-Menah
description: Each residence features expansive floor-to-ceiling windows that invite natural light and frame breathtaking urban vistas. Premium finishes, including Italian marble flooring and custom cabinetry, elevate the aesthetic of every room. Integrated smart-home technology allows for seamless control of climate, lighting, and security at your fingertips. Residents enjoy exclusive access to world-class amenities, including a private rooftop infinity pool and a state-of-the-art wellness center. These homes redefine urban elegance, offering a sophisticated sanctuary in the heart of the city’s most vibrant district.

name: City Center
description: A vibrant shopping mall designed to offer a complete retail and lifestyle experience. Discover a curated mix of premium brands, local boutiques, and flagship stores all under one elegant roof. Spacious walkways, contemporary architecture, and ambient lighting create a welcoming atmosphere for families and visitors. Enjoy a diverse selection of restaurants, cafés, and entertainment zones including cinemas and gaming arenas. With ample parking, modern security systems, and thoughtfully designed common areas, this shopping destination blends convenience, style, and comfort for an unforgettable day out.

name: KSRTC Bustand
description: The KSRTC Bus Stand in Puttur is a key public transportation hub serving the town of Puttur in Dakshina Kannada, Karnataka, India. Operated by the Karnataka State Road Transport Corporation, it connects Puttur with major towns and cities across Karnataka and neighbouring states through regular KSRTC services ranging from local daily routes to long-distance buses. The bus stand features multiple platforms and basic commuter facilities like waiting areas and restrooms, and provides convenient access for travellers heading to destinations such as Mangaluru, Bengaluru, Mysuru, and other regional centres. Its central location on Main Road makes it an important gateway for residents and visitors alike, offering easy access to onward local transport, ticket booking counters, and essential services for a comfortable journey
